1.

We have heard Mr. Vikram Thakor, learned advocate for the petitioners, Ms. Shruti Pathak,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for the State respondents and Ms.Archana Amin learned advocate for respondent nos.2 and 3.
2.
Learned advocates for the respondents waive service of notice of C/SCA/1043/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 rule.
With the consent of the learned advocates for the parties, matter is taken up for final hearing today.

sentences.text: In this petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has prayed to direct the respondents to pass a fresh award by determining compensation payable to the petitioners by applying Factor-2 as provided under Section 26(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Mr.Thakor would submit that the issue is covered by the decision dated 07.04.2022 of a coordinate Bench of this court rendered in the case of the Dmaheshbhai Kacharabhai Patel and others v. Competent Authority DFC and Another C/SCA/1043/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 rendered in Special Civil Application Nos.14509 of 2017 and allied matters.

entities.text: Dmaheshbhai Kacharabhai Patel and others v. Competent Authority DFC and Another C/SCA/1043/2023 ORDER
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. It is undisputed that the issue is covered by the decision of a coordinate Bench of this court rendered in the case of the Dhiraj Ambalal Patel vs. State of Gujarat [2020 (1) GLR 752].
6.

entities.text: Dhiraj Ambalal Patel vs. State of Gujarat [2020 (1) GLR 752]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the petition is allowed.

The concerned respondent authority is directed to pass award afresh by determining the compensation payable to the petitioners by applying factor - 2 as provided under section 26(2) of 2013 Act as the lands in question which have since been acquired is in rural area and compensation will have to be made accordingly.

The fresh award shall be passed within an outer limit of ten weeks from today and compensation shall be paid within four weeks from the date of C/SCA/1043/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 passing of the award.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of the above, the petition is allowed.
The concerned respondent authority is directed to pass award afresh by determining the compensation payable to the petitioners by applying factor - 2 as provided under section 26(2) of 2013 Act as the lands in question which have since been acquired is in rural area and compensation will have to be made accordingly.
The fresh award shall be passed within an outer limit of ten weeks from today and compensation shall be paid within four weeks from the date of C/SCA/1043/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 passing of the award.
Rule is made absolute accordingly.
